name: Room Scanner RGB Acoustic Twin
metric_frame: single WebXR local-floor session shared by all connected rooms
geometry_policy: explicit polygon closure; no user-facing minimum wall length; 1e-5 m numerical epsilon in core and UI; no operational minimum wall/corner distance
capture_guide: metric red/yellow/green quadrilaterals projected onto measured wall surfaces
target_semantics: red=no usable view; yellow=one view but another position required; green=complete
completion_policy: minimum three photos from two positions; unresolved targets remain guidance and never block completion
post_xr_handoff: end WebXR, release camera/depth/anchors/WebGL, persist JPEGs as separate IndexedDB records plus a lightweight checkpoint, reload, restore, then enable Deep
checkpoint_scope: separate JPEG records plus rooms, targets, synchronized photo poses, portals, RGB object voxels, object edits, acoustic surfaces and processing state
object_representation: colored voxel surface plus RGB point cloud, per-triangle acoustic face labels and editable oriented bounding box
acoustic_model: editable floor, ceiling, wall and object-face surfaces with 125-8000 Hz absorption and scattering
acoustic_inference: V10-style visual/material prior reconstructed from the requested behavior, capped at 0.28 confidence; never labelled as an RIR measurement
exports: RAW JSON, acoustic JSON/CSV, colored PLY, OBJ with optional per-vertex colors
asset_strategy: versioned executable assets plus network-first service worker
test_suite: 18 JavaScript test files plus syntax and JSON validation, including zero coefficients, compact JPEG records, stale frame IDs and mesh/acoustic mapping
headless_browser_test: attempted but not completed: container Chromium timed out without a usable screenshot
object_acoustic_mapping: every object mesh triangle is labelled bottom/top/front/back/right/left and linked through acoustic surface geometryRef
critical_asset_fallback: HTML fallback is navigation-only; missing JavaScript returns an error instead of HTML
